quality.review_scope: Independent main6+matchedSI5 scientific audit of accepted R2 passed. Cited full references remain unreviewed. Presentation refinements pending; no measured-coordinate admission.
missing_fields: Complete supplied six-page main and matched five-page SI read, including all main Figures 1–6, SI Figures S1–S2, seven SI equations, twenty main numbered references/notes and five SI references. Cited full texts remain unreviewed; independent source audit passed; presentation pending.
Core reaction temperature, atmosphere, vessel dimensions, addition rate and stirring speed are unreported. Stirring windows are retained rather than invented exact times.
Size-selective workup lacks solvent amounts, cycle counts, centrifugation speed and duration. Its printed solvent/antisolvent ordering discrepancy is retained.

Film nanocrystal concentration, individual drop volume, drying duration, substrate pretreatment, humidity and gas flow are unreported. Qualitative ambient/room temperature is not converted to a numeric temperature.

Film assembly uses previously synthesized nanocrystals. Exact batch IDs and preparation-to-figure crosswalks are not supplied; solvent conditions are not asserted to be independent new core syntheses. Au Figures 2A–F explicitly share one size fraction.

Superlattice fcc packing concerns nanocrystal organization, not a measurement of the atomic Au/Ag crystal phase, unit cell or atomic coordinates. Model curves and estimated diffusion lengths are not measured product structures.
Pure ethanol is listed among deposition solvents, but no separately resolved pure-ethanol outcome is supplied. No successful pure-ethanol route is invented.

The SI optical experiment has no reported input-particle size or exact link to a particular main-text film batch. Its dilution volume and post-adjustment mass are unreported; optical changes are not new growth/structure evidence.

Original source figures are proposed only under existing owner-directed display; publisher permission remains unverified. Molecule references and stage drawings are conceptual, with complete presentation pending.
conflicts: Detailed Results and Abstract describe the superlattice (111)s plane parallel to the substrate; the Summary instead says normal to the substrate. Structured packing follows the detailed Results and the contrary summary remains explicit.

The workup first identifies ethanol as the antisolvent but subsequently prints ethanol/chloroform as the solvent/antisolvent pair. The ordering discrepancy is retained; no silent solvent-role reversal is made.
The general study size range is 5–7 nm, while the specific Ag Figure 1 caption reports 7.2 ± 0.6 nm. The figure-specific value is not truncated to the rounded general range.
SI calls its absorption coefficient molar absorptivity but reports cm2/mg. The source term and mass-specific units are retained without conversion.

SI Equation 2 defines d as center-to-center distance, whereas Figure S1 labels a 25–50 Å separation-distance axis for 6.3 nm particles. No measured spacing or unambiguous center distance is read from that model plot.
